messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to retrieve real‑time or historical holiday calendars directly from external services. However, I can give you a quick overview of the major public holidays in Canada for 2023 that typically create long weekends:

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Typical Long Weekend |
|-------------|---------|----------------------|
| Jan 1 (Sun) | New Year’s Day | Jan 1–2 (Sat–Sun) |
| Feb 20 (Mon) | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, NB) | Feb 18–20 (Fri–Sun) |
| Mar 17 (Thu) | St. Patrick’s Day (some provinces) | Mar 17–19 (Thu–Sat) |
| Apr 7 (Mon) | Good Friday | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) |
| May 22 (Mon) | Victoria Day | May 21–23 (Sun–Tue) |
| Jun 19 (Mon) | National Indigenous Peoples Day (NL) | Jun 19–21 (Mon–Wed) |
| Jul 1 (Sat) | Canada Day | Jul 1–3 (Sat–Mon) |
| Sep 4 (Mon) | Labour Day | Sep 4–6 (Mon–Wed) |
| Oct 10 (Mon) | Thanksgiving (most provinces) | Oct 9–11 (Sun–Tue) |
| Nov 7 (Mon) | Remembrance Day (observed) | Nov 7–9 (Mon–Wed) |
| Dec 25 (Mon) | Christmas Day | Dec 24–26 (Sun–Tue) |
| Dec 26 (Tue) | Boxing Day | Dec 26–28 (Tue–Thu) |

If you need a comprehensive, province‑specific list or want to pull this data programmatically, you could consider using a public holidays API such as **Calendarific** or **Abstract Public Holidays**, which offer endpoints for Canadian holidays by year and region. Let me know if you’d like guidance on how to call one of those APIs!
